cases.purpose: For every single inode-flag bit (0..31), the all-ones word and feature/common combinations delivered through a mocked FS_IOC_GETFLAGS, lsattr prints the same letter string (letters and positions: s u S D i a d A c E j t T e V C x m N P F ...) as e2fsprogs lsattr.
cases.oracle: e2fsprogs lsattr reading a deterministic FS_IOC_GETFLAGS word: a seccomp-notify supervisor writes the chosen flags word into the caller's buffer and answers success, for the reference tool and the candidate alike; letters and order per e2fsprogs.
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status, stdout, stderr and file tree.
cases.script:
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
: > f; /usr/bin/mkdir d
one() { /usr/bin/python3 flagmock.py "$1" -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "lsattr $2" 2>&1; }
for ((i=0;i<32;i++)); do m=$((1<<i)); printf 'bit%02d %s\n' $i "$(one $m f)"; done
printf 'all-bits %s\n' "$(one 0xffffffff f)"
printf 'extents-only %s\n' "$(one 0x80000 f)"
printf 'common-combo %s\n' "$(one $((0x1|0x2|0x8|0x10|0x20|0x40|0x80|0x4000|0x8000|0x10000|0x20000|0x80000)) f)"
printf 'feature-combo %s\n' "$(one $((0x10000000|0x40000000|0x20000000|0x100000|0x800|0x80000)) f)"
printf 'dir-flags %s\n' "$(one $((0x1000|0x80000|0x40000000)) '-d d')"
